name: The R Villa Samalas
bedroomsText: 4 (3 bedrooms with their own en-suite bathroom, 1 bunk-bed room without its own bathroom), plus a sofa bed in the living room

facts.text: 4 bedrooms: 3 of them have their own en-suite bathroom, 1 is a bunk-bed room without a bathroom of its own. There are 3 bathrooms in total.
There is a sofa bed in the living room.
The plot is 300 m² and includes the garden, the pool and the pool deck. That is plot size, not living space. Never call it villa size or living area.
Private pool with a pool deck.
A garden that is part of the living area (outdoor living around the pool).
In a quiet residential lane in Pererenan. A cafe, a 24-hour shop and a spa are a few minutes on foot (see the AREA list).
Pererenan Beach is about 2.5 km away, about 7 minutes by scooter. It is a beach for sunset and surf-watching, not for swimming (strong currents, no lifeguards). The villa is not beachfront.
facts.source: Elev8 area guide, 2026-11 (the guide also names 1.9 km once; 2.5 km appears three times)

facts.text: Air conditioning, WiFi, TV, safe, hair dryer, iron and ironing board.
Kitchen with stove, microwave, coffee maker, toaster, blender, a refrigerator with freezer and a mini fridge; dining table.
Parking in front of the gate for one car.

open: Living area in m² is not known. Do not state any size other than the 300 m² plot.
No view claims (rice fields, sunset, ocean) are confirmed.
Never call the villa beachfront or say the sea is for swimming.
Whether a crib and highchair are kept on site is unclear (the questionnaire says yes, the add-on says order in advance). Do not mention them.
Hot tub, barbecue, gym, cinema and rooftop are not confirmed. Do not mention them.
